ValidationRule.description: Following fields are required if any "Meeting Type" value other than Technical Discovery is selcted. This was created per Shawn Surber's Request
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "TAM_Request", OR( TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "Demo", TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "Event", TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "General Capabilities Discussion", TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "Other (please specify in “Additional Meeting Info)", TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "Technical Deep Dive (Modules, Use Cases)", TEXT(Meeting_Type_Picklist__c) = "Pilot Planning" ), OR( ISBLANK(Date_of_Meeting__c), ISBLANK(Time_of_Meeting__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Time_Zone__c)), ISBLANK(Number_of_Attendees__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Following fields are required Date of Meeting, Time of Meeting, Time Zone and Number of Attendees
